user.title: Poolex TSOL-MX800 Balcony
user.description: Connect directly to the inverter over your local network. The device ID and local key are used only for the encrypted Tuya LAN session.

data_description.device_ip: The inverter's fixed or reserved IP address.
data_description.device_id: Tuya app: device settings > device information > virtual ID.
data_description.local_key: Tuya IoT Platform > Devices > Local Key. Keep this value private.
data_description.poll_interval: 1-300 seconds are supported. The default is 1 second; higher values reduce device/network load.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read the inverter over the local network.

init.title: Poolex TSOL-MX800 Balcony options
init.description: Adjust how often the inverter is polled over the local network.

data_description.poll_interval: The supported range is 1-300 seconds. The default is 1 second; higher values reduce device/network load.
